scope: frontend-v3 safe foundation, backend core contract readiness, and synthetic E2E evidence
policy: Do not mark a workstream completed without backend contract, authorization, state machine, audit, idempotency, concurrency, tests, remote CI and staging evidence where applicable.

items.securityImpact: Identity and consent misuse if verification or sharing is inferred locally.
items.financialImpact: Potential privacy and regulatory exposure; no financial write enabled.
items.rootCause: Self-service session/device/verification and discovery contracts are not admitted in the frontend boundary.
items.currentBehavior: Server-reflected workspaces and consent withdrawal only; verification integrations are visibly gated.
items.expectedBehavior: Use explicit backend contracts with evidence, retention, rate limits and audit before enabling.
items.remediation: Keep gated; add typed contract fixtures and negative tests.

items.securityImpact: Object-level access and cross-tenant leakage risk if broad patient access is opened.
items.clinicalImpact: Wrong-patient care or unsigned clinical mutation.
items.rootCause: Only patients/orders canonical reads are admitted; encounter and clinical write contracts are absent.
items.currentBehavior: Workspace switch precedes limited reads; writes and legacy fallbacks are gated.
items.expectedBehavior: Patient access decision must prove session, workspace, membership, organization, relationship, purpose and scope.
items.remediation: Keep read-only; implement state-machine and authorization fixtures before write UI.

items.securityImpact: Privilege escalation or cross-tenant organization mutation.
items.financialImpact: Unauthorized licensing, billing or inventory changes.
items.rootCause: Organization and IAM lifecycle decisions belong to backend ownership and membership policies.
items.currentBehavior: Displays server-reflected workspaces/memberships; creation and assignment are gated.
items.expectedBehavior: Ownership, membership, scope and approval must be enforced server-side.
items.remediation: Keep CRUD gated; document action matrix and tenant tests.

items.securityImpact: Unauthorized result release or specimen tampering.
items.clinicalImpact: Wrong or unvalidated result reaching a clinician or citizen.
items.rootCause: LIS/specimen/result contracts and senior validation policy are not admitted.
items.currentBehavior: Demo is synthetic; Live is limited to workspace and orders reads.
items.expectedBehavior: Enforce specimen chain of custody and result state machine server-side.
items.remediation: Keep validation/release blocked; add transition and negative fixtures.

items.securityImpact: Unauthorized dispense, controlled-medicine access or inventory mutation.
items.clinicalImpact: Wrong medication, dose, batch or patient.
items.financialImpact: Duplicate sale, stock or settlement corruption.
items.rootCause: Prescription verification, pharmacist authorization and inventory ledger contracts are absent.
items.currentBehavior: Demo read-only and limited Live reads; dispensing and POS writes are blocked.
items.expectedBehavior: Separate prescription, verification, dispensing, administration and financial ledgers.
items.remediation: Keep dispense/POS blocked; model partial dispensing and rejection fixtures only.

items.financialImpact: Incorrect study billing or external import reconciliation.
items.rootCause: RIS/PACS/DICOM and report lifecycle contracts are unavailable to the frontend boundary.
items.currentBehavior: Limited metadata only; image URLs, reports, signing and release are gated.
items.expectedBehavior: Object-scoped order/study/report access with signed lifecycle and audit.
items.remediation: Keep metadata gate and forbid fabricated DICOM/PACS URLs.

items.clinicalImpact: Incorrect diagnosis, orders, prescription or follow-up.
items.currentBehavior: Demo and limited reads only; clinical mutations are gated.
items.expectedBehavior: Encounter lifecycle and notes must be versioned, signed and amended explicitly.
items.remediation: Keep clinical writes blocked; add contract gate and error-state coverage.

items.securityImpact: Facility/ward cross-scope access and unsafe operational writes.
items.clinicalImpact: Wrong admission, bed, medication, ICU or discharge action.
items.financialImpact: Incorrect occupancy, billing or resource accounting.
items.rootCause: Broad `/hospital/*` APIs are not frontend-safe workspace/ward scoped.
items.currentBehavior: Safe Demo and patients/orders Live reads; `/hospital` aliases the safe workspace.
items.expectedBehavior: Separate admission, bed, nursing/eMAR, ICU, OR, blood bank and discharge contracts.
items.remediation: Do not wire broad endpoints; design facility/ward-scoped contracts.

items.securityImpact: Break-glass abuse and sensitive emergency data exposure.
items.clinicalImpact: Unsafe emergency action or missing escalation.
items.rootCause: Emergency/EMS/Break-Glass contracts and authorized integrations are absent.
items.currentBehavior: Synthetic Demo; `/ems` and `/critical-care` alias the safe workspace; Live is limited.
items.expectedBehavior: Mandatory reason, minimal dataset, time limit, automatic expiry, alert, review and audit.
items.remediation: Keep all emergency writes, GPS, ePCR and telemetry gated.

items.securityImpact: Ambiguous UI states can cause unsafe user assumptions.
items.clinicalImpact: A gated or stale state could be mistaken for current clinical truth.
items.rootCause: Full localization/platform parity and production telemetry require review and environments.
items.currentBehavior: Shared tokens, RTL, dark mode, reduced motion, ARIA and state primitives are implemented.
items.expectedBehavior: Reviewed resources and equivalent behavior on Web/Mobile/Desktop with visual/accessibility evidence.
items.remediation: Continue component and localization review; keep status language explicit.

items.securityImpact: Users could mistake synthetic screens for live capability.
items.clinicalImpact: No live clinical mutation; risk is expectation confusion.
items.rootCause: Gallery is a UX reference and lacks backend bindings and cross-platform E2E.
items.expectedBehavior: Each production screen must have a canonical contract and evidence bundle.
items.remediation: Keep explicit Demo labeling and contract gates.

items.securityImpact: False readiness claims could lead to unsafe rollout.
items.clinicalImpact: End-to-end clinical integrity is not proven.
items.rootCause: Cross-domain Appointment → Encounter → Lab → Result → Review → Citizen → Share → Revoke → Audit backend contracts and remote evidence are missing.
items.currentBehavior: Readiness is explicitly partial; no `GOLDEN PATH PASSED` claim.
items.expectedBehavior: Synthetic Test Backend proves the full stateful workflow and negative/security cases.
items.remediation: Use typed state registry and keep all writes gated until evidence exists.
